name: Side Kicks
summary: Lying on the side, kick front and back, lift and lower, and circle the top leg.
steps: Lie on one side in a long line, legs slightly forward of the body, head on the arm.
Lift the top leg to hip height.
Kick it forward, then sweep it back, without the trunk moving.
Add lifts, circles and inner-thigh lifts.

layers.title: Front and back
layers.text: Two small kicks forward, one long reach back.

layers.title: Up and down
layers.text: Lift the top leg and lower it slowly.

layers.title: Circles
layers.text: Small circles each way from the hip.

cues:
The waist stays still while the leg moves.
Hips stacked.
Leg long, reaching out of the hip.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Inner-thigh lifts
variations.note: Top leg crossed over, bottom leg lifts.

variations.name: Bend the bottom knee for balance
Top hand on the mat in front
